sys_hub_action_type_definition.description: Returns the days of a time card already sent to Xero, read from the Xero Time Entry Sync table (Status = Sent). Output format: YYYY-MM-DD, comma separated, the same format used by Xero - Get Time Card to skip days already sent. Replaces Xero - Get Time Entries, so no call is made to Xero.
sys_hub_action_type_definition.name: Xero - Get Sent Dates
